contracts: Render_BuildActorRecords and Render_BuildActorRecordsOnly write four-word X/attribute/tile/Y records at 0x00FF729A.
The builders append a 1/0/0/1 terminator record and publish the low-byte record count through 0x00FFEFEC.
Render_SubmitPlayerSprites reads 0x00FFEFEC and streams two longwords per record from 0x00FF729A to the VDP, rejecting counts at or above 0x80.
evidence: Exact 68000 disassembly of the two builders and their consumer
limitations: The buffer name covers HUD, player, and actor records because all three use the same producer path; no narrower ownership is inferred.
The count description preserves the terminator-inclusive implementation detail without assigning a separate terminator object identity.
conclusion: The generated Unknown_00FF729A and Unknown_00FFEFEC identities are replaced by stable renderer buffer/count names while preserving the exact VDP record contract.
